workflow.name: S14c_0F Bep nhin nguoc
workflow.description: S14c We Talked About This (bản da đen), ảnh nền trống bếp nhìn từ đầu bồn rửa về phía bếp gas và cửa bếp (ban đêm cho S10, S12; vài tuần sau cho S85), sửa từ ảnh bếp buổi sáng. Tải ảnh vào: IMG_BG_B_MORNING = ảnh đã chọn của node BG_B_MORNING_FIX ở S14c_0A2; IMG_BG_B_NIGHT = ảnh đã chọn của node BG_B_NIGHT ở S14c_0B2; IMG_BG_B_CLEAR = ảnh đã chọn của node BG_B_CLEAR ở S14c_0B2. Chạy sau 0B2. Mỗi node chọn 1 ảnh: cùng tủ trắng, quầy, bếp gas trắng, máy hút mùi, quạt giấy và điện thoại tường như ảnh bếp; cuối bếp, ngay sau bếp gas, có cửa mở ra hành lang; không người, không chữ; tải về dùng cho S10, S12 (ảnh đêm) và S85 (ảnh vài tuần sau).

Make a new photo of this same empty kitchen from the other end: the camera now stands in the aisle at the sink end of the kitchen, at standing eye level, and looks back toward the range end. In the frame: along the screen-left side, the laminate counter with the white cabinets above and below it, the wall receiver and the paper church fan on the wall, and the old white gas range with its range hood and the cast-iron skillet at the far end of the counter; at the end of the kitchen, just past the range, an open doorway with a plain white door frame leading into the hallway; at screen-right, the plain cream wall across the aisle; the fridge and the white step trash can beside it are behind the camera, out of the frame. Keep everything that belongs to the room exactly as in Image 1: the same white cabinets and their handles, laminate counter, white gas range, range hood, cast-iron skillet, wall receiver, church fan, walls and floor. The room now: the white crock of teal silicone utensils stands on the counter beside the range; night outside the window; the kitchen is lit only by the warm yellow light under the range hood, falling across the stove and the counter, and the rest of the room falls into soft shadow where the cabinets and the floor stay readable, never pitch black; the hallway beyond the doorway is dim. Look: night, the kitchen lit only by the warm yellow range-hood light, the rest of the room falling into soft shadow, quiet and tense. Looking like an ordinary frame from a real camera with a normal lens, not a render; true-to-life gentle colors and soft natural contrast; fine natural grain; the far background a touch softer than the foreground. No over-sharpening, no HDR, no CGI look. No people. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text, no logos. Final check: the same kitchen as in Image 1, now seen from the sink end toward the range and the open doorway; nobody in the room.
